title: Dark-Sector Bicriticality in Hyperscaling-Violating Holographic Superfluids
summary: We show analytically that a dark-scalar order can preempt anisotropic $p$-wave order in a gauge-invariant hyperscaling-violating holographic superfluid. Near a point where the source-free scalar and vector instabilities coincide, their grand potentials can be compared in closed perturbative form. The homogeneous coexistence solution is a saddle, so the preferred state switches directly between an anisotropic vector-condensed phase and an isotropic dark-scalar-condensed phase across a first-order line.
